text:
marin-finance: Heads-up: Customer AxiomWorks (private deployment) reported a billing mismatch. They were moved from EnterprisePrime to Core on 2026-04-20 but we left the platform-fee line on invoice INV-100114 unchanged. Need a short settlement path before renewal notice next week.

oliver-billing: Can you confirm the SOW and whether a reseller is on the chain? I need the effective date to run proration.

marin-finance: SOW AX-77-B. Reseller channel is handled by BrightPath (alex-resellerops). Effective 2026-04-20. Customer prefers a credit memo rather than reissuing invoice.

billing-bot: Metering export created: /exports/axiomworks_216543_batch.csv

billing-bot: CSV snippet:
```
2026-03-01,platform_fee,1,72000
2026-03-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,5000,0
2026-04-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,1400,0
2026-04-20,change_event,1,0
```

tess-account: Quick ask from AxiomWorks: if we issue a credit memo they want a short release clause in the memo and confirmation that partner commissions won't be clawed back.

kai-cs: Customer indicated downgrade due to narrower feature set in private deploy. They agree to a single credit number and a one-line statement "final settlement for platform fee adjustment".

nina-legal: We'll add a settlement paragraph: "Customer releases Redwood Inference from further claims related to platform fee differential arising from the 2026-04-20 support tier change." Need finance lead sign-off. Also need to confirm partner commission handling.

marin-finance: Numbers: EnterprisePrime annual platform fee = $72,000. Core annual platform fee = $40,000. Annual delta = $32,000. Remaining months from 2026-04-20 to 2027-01-01 = ~8.37 months (8.37/12 = 0.6975). Prorated delta = $32,000 * 0.6975 = $22,320. Customer asks we round to nearest $50 => $22,300.

oliver-billing: I can generate provisional credit CM-216543-01 for $22,300 and set status = PendingPartnerAck. However partner ops will need to explicitly waive commission clawback or we risk reversing commissions. Tagging alex-resellerops.

alex-resellerops: BrightPath sees revenue reversal impact if invoice is changed. We can approve "no clawback" for this case if legal attaches a short partner acknowledgement and finance posts the credit as "settlement: partner-approved". I'll queue Ops approval; expect ack in 2 hrs.

sara-cfo: Approve $22,300 credit and settlement language, contingent on partner ops ack. Sara-cfo: signing off.

oliver-billing: Created provisional CM-216543-01 ($22,300), status PendingPartnerAck, posted internal note on SOW AX-77-B. Notifying AR and collections to hold.

alex-resellerops: Partner Ops ack: BrightPath confirms no commission clawback for CM-216543-01. Sending internal confirmation email now.

nina-legal: Received partner ops confirmation. Finalizing settlement paragraph and attaching to the credit memo.

oliver-billing: Updated CM-216543-01 to Final, posted to AR, and created accounting memo "AX-77-B_platformfee_adj_216543". Collections released hold.

tess-account: Customer accepted the wording and amount. I'll attach the memo to the renewal thread and email the credit memo PDF to AxiomWorks accounts payable.

marin-finance: Great. Filing this under SOW AX-77-B and closing. Note for audit: tracked in FinanceOps ticket FO-3192. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
